response: Bipolar disorders can be underdiagnosed in patients with depressive episodes. The diagnosis of bipolar disorder (BD) in patients with major depressive episodes (MDE) depends strongly on the method and criteria employed. This suggests that the use of specific criteria lists in clinical settings can be useful in improving the accuracy of diagnosis. However, the complexity of diagnosing BD, especially when patients present with depressive episodes, indicates that careful evaluation and consideration of various diagnostic criteria are necessary to ensure accurate diagnosis and appropriate treatment.
